$comment: Managed-storage policy schema for the BlissWork Activity extension. An MDM/Group-Policy admin sets these to enrol a managed browser without the member pasting anything; the extension reads them from chrome.storage.managed. DELIBERATELY OMITTED: captureAll and captureIncognito. The scope of capture (whether the sensitive-category floor and incognito protections apply) is NOT policy-controllable, so comprehensive surveillance cannot be pushed to a fleet from a single policy change. The floor stays on unless someone changes a flag on an individual device.

token.title: Ingest token
token.description: The per-member ingest secret minted in BlissWork (Settings -> Your activity). One (org, user); write-only; revocable from BlissWork. Provisioning this per device is what enrols a member without them pasting it themselves.

blocked.title: Additional never-record fragments
blocked.description: Host or host+path substrings this organisation chooses to never record, always honoured on top of the built-in category floor.
